import test from 'node:test'
import assert from 'node:assert'
import { execute } from '../lib/impl.js'
test('schema', async () => {
  assert.equal((await execute({ required: ['a', 'b'], data: { a: 1 } })).ok, false)
  assert.equal((await execute({ required: ['a'], data: { a: 1 } })).ok, true)
})
